sql: SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)) AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2 WHERE c.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)))
